creator: Alexander Terp
description: ./dev --contract uses /tmp/muster-contract for every checkout, so two worktrees running the tier at once share it: on 2026-09-28 one check's home vanished and two saw command.unprotected (a command connection dropped before it was served) while another checkout's --contract ran. Each run should get a directory of its own (per checkout or per process), still short enough for socket paths.
title: Two checkouts' contract tiers collide in /tmp/muster-contract
